run.subject: Which clearances, assessments, determinations and open cases would have to be revisited if the status or ownership of Meridian Holdings I S.à r.l. changed?
run.final_text:
{"status": "answered", "answer": "Meridian Holdings I S.à r.l. is party I-006 in the investor register. Six records rest on recorded facts about it and would have to be looked at again if its status or ownership changed: one clearance, two assessments, two determinations and one open case.

- Clearance CL-006 (cleared) relies on tax form F-006 and ownership declaration DO-003.
- Assessment A-R012 (component D-001-A, undetermined) uses commitment C-006, ownership declarations DO-004, DO-005 and DO-006, the LU residence record from 2017-01-01 and tax form F-006.
- Assessment A-R027 (component D-001-B, not applicable) uses commitment C-006.
- Determination WS-R001-08 (component D-001-A, default rate) is supported by assessment A-R012.
- Determination WS-R001-23 (component D-001-B, not applicable) is supported by assessment A-R027.
- Case K-006 is an open change case concerning I-006, triggered by a change to ownership declaration DO-003.

This is a list of records to revisit, not of records that would change; whether a treatment changes depends on the new fact. The assessments and determinations are those of the last WF3 run, and only determinations of the latest withholding schedule are included.

CL-006 relies on declaration DO-003, while the declarations in force for I-006 today (2026-10-09) are DO-004 and DO-005, valid from 2026-08-01. Case K-006 is already open on the change to DO-003.", "facts": [{"subject": "CL-006", "attribute": "kind", "value": "clearance", "source_ref": "clearance.clearance:CL-006"}, {"subject": "A-R012", "attribute": "kind", "value": "assessment", "source_ref": "clearance.obligation_assessment:A-R012"}, {"subject": "A-R027", "attribute": "kind", "value": "assessment", "source_ref": "clearance.obligation_assessment:A-R027"}, {"subject": "WS-R001-08", "attribute": "kind", "value": "determination", "source_ref": "clearance.withholding_determination:WS-R001-08"}, {"subject": "WS-R001-23", "attribute": "kind", "value": "determination", "source_ref": "clearance.withholding_determination:WS-R001-23"}, {"subject": "K-006", "attribute": "kind", "value": "case", "source_ref": "clearance.case:K-006"}], "unknown": ["Whether any of these records would actually change: that depends on the new fact, which the sources cannot record in advance.", "Determinations on withholding schedules earlier than the latest one are not listed by the computation."], "conflicts": []}

steps.executed:
SELECT e.entity_id AS entity, e.legal_name AS name, e.legal_form,
       e.is_fund = 'Y' AS fund_vehicle, e.is_spv = 'Y' AS spv, e.is_portco = 'Y' AS portfolio_company,
       'entity_mgmt.legal_entity:' || e.entity_id AS source_ref
FROM entity_mgmt.legal_entity e
ORDER BY e.entity_id
steps.verdict: The sanctioned computation ran and the result is as reported.

steps.executed:
SELECT r.inv_no AS party_no, i.display_name AS name, r.country, r.from_dt AS valid_from, r.to_dt AS valid_to,
       'onboarding.residence_record:' || r.inv_no || '/' || r.country || '/' || r.from_dt AS source_ref
FROM onboarding.residence_record r
JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = r.inv_no
WHERE r.from_dt <= %(on_date)s::date AND (r.to_dt IS NULL OR r.to_dt >= %(on_date)s::date)
ORDER BY r.inv_no
steps.verdict: The sanctioned computation ran and the result is as reported.

steps.executed:
SELECT o.owned_inv_no AS party_no, owned.display_name AS name, o.owner_inv_no AS owner_no, owner.display_name AS owner_name,
       owner.country_res AS owner_residence, o.pct_econ AS economic_pct, o.pct_vote AS voting_pct,
       o.from_dt AS valid_from, o.to_dt AS valid_to, o.doc_ref AS evidenced_by,
       'onboarding.declared_owner:' || o.decl_id AS source_ref
FROM onboarding.declared_owner o
JOIN investor_register.investor owned ON owned.inv_no = o.owned_inv_no
JOIN investor_register.investor owner ON owner.inv_no = o.owner_inv_no
WHERE o.alloc_basis = 'OWNERSHIP'
  AND o.from_dt <= %(on_date)s::date AND (o.to_dt IS NULL OR o.to_dt >= %(on_date)s::date)
ORDER BY o.owned_inv_no, o.owner_inv_no
steps.verdict: The sanctioned computation ran and the result is as reported.

steps.executed:
WITH fact (source_ref) AS (
    SELECT 'onboarding.tax_form:' || form_id FROM onboarding.tax_form WHERE inv_no = %(party_no)s
    UNION ALL SELECT 'onboarding.tax_status:' || status_id FROM onboarding.tax_status WHERE inv_no = %(party_no)s
    UNION ALL SELECT 'onboarding.residence_record:' || inv_no || '/' || country || '/' || from_dt FROM onboarding.residence_record WHERE inv_no = %(party_no)s
    UNION ALL SELECT 'investor_register.commitment:' || commit_id FROM investor_register.commitment WHERE inv_no = %(party_no)s
    UNION ALL SELECT 'onboarding.declared_owner:' || decl_id FROM onboarding.declared_owner WHERE %(party_no)s IN (owned_inv_no, owner_inv_no)
), cleared AS (
    SELECT c.clearance_id, c.clearance_of, c.clearance_status, array_agg(r.source_ref ORDER BY r.source_ref) AS rests_on
    FROM clearance.clearance c JOIN clearance.clearance_reliance r USING (clearance_id) JOIN fact USING (source_ref)
    GROUP BY c.clearance_id, c.clearance_of, c.clearance_status
), assessed AS (
    SELECT a.assessment_id, a.subject_party, a.subject_event, a.assessment_result, array_agg(f.source_ref ORDER BY f.source_ref) AS rests_on
    FROM clearance.obligation_assessment a JOIN clearance.assessment_fact f USING (assessment_id) JOIN fact USING (source_ref)
    GROUP BY a.assessment_id, a.subject_party, a.subject_event, a.assessment_result
)
SELECT 'clearance' AS kind, clearance_id AS record, clearance_of AS party, NULL AS component, clearance_status AS state, rests_on,
       'clearance.clearance:' || clearance_id AS source_ref
FROM cleared
UNION ALL
SELECT 'assessment', assessment_id, subject_party, subject_event, assessment_result, rests_on, 'clearance.obligation_assessment:' || assessment_id
FROM assessed
UNION ALL
SELECT 'determination', d.determination_id, d.determined_for, d.for_component, d.determination_outcome,
       array_remove(ARRAY[(SELECT 'clearance.obligation_assessment:' || assessment_id FROM assessed WHERE assessment_id = d.supported_by),
                          (SELECT 'clearance.clearance:' || clearance_id FROM cleared WHERE clearance_id = d.relies_on_clearance)], NULL),
       'clearance.withholding_determination:' || d.determination_id
FROM clearance.withholding_determination d
WHERE d.schedule_id = (SELECT max(schedule_id) FROM clearance.withholding_schedule)
  AND (d.supported_by IN (SELECT assessment_id FROM assessed) OR d.relies_on_clearance IN (SELECT clearance_id FROM cleared))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'case', k.case_id, k.concerns_party, NULL, k.case_kind || ', open', array_remove(ARRAY[e.changes_ref], NULL), 'clearance.case:' || k.case_id
FROM clearance.case k LEFT JOIN clearance.change_event e ON e.change_id = k.triggered_by
WHERE k.closed_on IS NULL AND (k.concerns_party = %(party_no)s OR e.changes_ref IN (SELECT source_ref FROM fact))
ORDER BY 1, 2
steps.verdict: The sanctioned computation ran and the result is as reported.
